name: Code
description: Your workspace as VS Code's workbench: tiles in an explorer, each a tab with its live terminal, every frame's code and changes, watched beside the agent writing them.
author: Hivemind

commands.name: editors
commands.description: What is open: each editor group's tabs and the one shown, the panel's terminals and tab, and the side bar's view.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open the tile whose name holds this text as a tab in the active group, to the side in a new group, or in the panel.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Close the tab of the tile whose name holds this text. The tile keeps running.

commands.name: code
commands.description: Open a frame's code (its files, an editor and the working tree's changes, which the app watches as agents write): the named frame's, else the frame of the tile shown.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Watch: beside whichever agent or terminal is shown, its frame's code, following as you move between agents. Says whether it is on.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Show or hide the side bar and the panel, pick the side bar's view or the panel's tab.
